what: On hover, the letters, starting from the front, each slip up half a line at .025s intervals and vanish (40%). They then move half a line down and hide (41 to 60%), and rise from below back into place. Each letter takes .4s ease. Only on wide screens (835 and up) with a mouse, once per hover.

options.each: Delay between letters (sec), default .025 — the first letter also starts one step late
options.ease: Curve (four numbers or CSS name), default ease
options.min: Turns on only at this width (px) or above, default 835
options.[data-fx-part=text]: (Optional) text to split — if none, the element’s own text

from.where: shared menu panel and footer menu links (.al-gnav__nav a · .al-footer__nav a)
